name: Memory Append
description: Append structured entries into daily memory Markdown files (memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md) and inject a Recent memories hint from today's file into prompts. Delegates to the Go binary for locking and formatting.

registryUrl.description: Project registry API base URL for Discord channel/thread → project resolution.

registryToken.description: Key name in registryEnvFile (or OS environment) that holds the registry auth secret. The literal secret value is never stored here.

registryEnvFile.description: Path to .env file containing the registryToken key. If unset, the binary reads secrets from the OS environment only.

binaryPath.description: Explicit path to the memory-append Go binary. Overrides sandbox/host defaults.

discordAccountId.description: Discord bot account id for registry resolution. Defaults to ctx.agentAccountId.

recentMaxLines.description: Maximum number of recent memory lines to inject into prompts (default 20).

recentMaxChars.description: Maximum total characters of recent memory text to inject into prompts (default 4000).

recentMaxLineChars.description: Per-line truncation cap for recent memory lines in the prompt (default 800).
